journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics

articles.title_en: When Work Moves: Job Suburbanization and Black Employment
articles.title_cn: 当工作迁移时：工作郊区化与黑人就业
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines whether job suburbanization caused declines in black employment rates from 1970 to 2000. I find that black workers are less likely than white workers to work in observably similar jobs that are located further from the central city. Using evidence from establishment relocations, I find that this relationship reflects at least in part the causal effect of job location. At the local labor market level, I find that job suburbanization is associated with substantial declines in black employment rates relative to white employment rates. Evidence from nationally planned highway infrastructure corroborates a causal interpretation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了工作郊区化是否导致了1970年至2000年间黑人就业率的下降。我发现，与白人工人相比，黑人工人更不可能在可观察到的相似工作中从事位于远离中心城市的工作。利用企业搬迁的证据，我发现这种关系至少部分反映了工作地点的因果效应。在地方劳动力市场层面，我发现工作郊区化与黑人就业率相对于白人就业率的显著下降有关。来自国家规划的高速公路基础设施的证据证实了因果解释。

articles.title_en: Commuting, Labor, and Housing Market Effects of Mass Transportation: Welfare and Identification
articles.title_cn: 公共交通的通勤、劳动力与住房市场效应：福利与识别
articles.abstract_en: I study Los Angeles Metro Rail's effects using panel data on bilateral commuting flows, a quantitative spatial model, and historically motivated quasi-experimental research designs. The model separates transit's commuting effects from local productivity or amenity effects, and spatial shift-share instruments identify inelastic labor and housing supply. Metro Rail connections increase commuting by 16% but do not have large effects on local productivity or amenities. Metro Rail generates $94 million in annual benefits by 2000 or 12–25% of annualized costs. Accounting for reduced congestion and slow transit adoption adds, at most, another $200 million in annual benefits.
articles.abstract_cn: 我利用双边通勤流的面板数据、定量空间模型以及基于历史动机的准实验研究设计，研究了洛杉矶地铁铁路的影响。该模型将公共交通的通勤效应与当地生产率或便利性效应区分开来，空间偏移份额工具识别出无弹性的劳动力和住房供给。地铁铁路连接增加了16%的通勤量，但对当地生产率或便利性没有显著影响。地铁铁路到2000年每年产生94百万美元的收益，相当于年化成本的12-25%。考虑到拥堵减少和公共交通采用缓慢，每年最多再增加200百万美元的收益。

articles.title_en: Rules of Thumb and Attention Elasticities: Evidence from Under- and Overreaction to Taxes
articles.title_cn: 经验法则与注意力弹性：来自对税收反应不足和反应过度的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper tests costly attention models of consumers' misreaction to opaque taxes. We report an online shopping experiment that involves shrouded sales taxes that are exogenously varied within consumers over time. Some consumers systematically underreact to sales taxes whereas others systematically overreact, but higher stakes decrease both under- and overreaction. This is consistent with consumers using heterogeneous rules of thumb to compute the opaque tax when the stakes are low, but using costly mental effort at higher stakes. The results allow us to differentiate between various theories of limited attention. We also develop novel econometric techniques for quantifying individual differences.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文检验了消费者对不透明税收错误反应的注意力成本模型。我们报告了一项在线购物实验，其中涉及在消费者内部随时间外生变化的隐性销售税。一些消费者系统性地对销售税反应不足，而另一些则系统性地反应过度，但更高的金额会减少反应不足和反应过度。这与消费者在金额较低时使用异质性经验法则来计算不透明税收，而在金额较高时使用昂贵的脑力劳动相一致。结果使我们能够区分各种有限注意力理论。我们还开发了用于量化个体差异的新颖计量经济学技术。

articles.title_en: Health, Longevity, and Welfare Inequality of Older Americans
articles.title_cn: 美国老年人的健康、寿命与福利不平等
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the distribution of well-being among the older U.S. population using an expected utility framework that incorporates differences in consumption, leisure, health, and mortality. We find large disparities in welfare that have increased over time. Incorporating the cost of living with poor health into elderly welfare substantially increases the overall inequality. Disparity measures based on cross-sectional income or consumption underestimate the growth in aggregate welfare inequality. Moreover, health is a better indicator of an individual's relative welfare position than income or consumption.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个包含消费、休闲、健康和死亡率差异的预期效用框架，估计了美国老年人口的福利分布。我们发现福利存在巨大差异，且这些差异随时间推移而扩大。将带病生存的生活成本纳入老年福利计算，显著增加了总体不平等。基于横截面收入或消费的差异度量低估了总体福利不平等的增长。此外，健康比收入或消费更能反映个体相对福利地位。

articles.title_en: Regime Stability and the Persistence of Traditional Practices
articles.title_cn: 政权稳定性与传统习俗的持续性
articles.abstract_en: I examine why the harmful tradition of female genital mutilation (FGM) persists in certain countries but in others it has been eradicated. People are more willing to abandon their traditions if they are confident that the government is durable enough to set up long-term replacements for them. Using a country-ethnicity panel data set spanning 23 countries from 1970 to 2013 and artificial partition of African ethnic groups by national borders, I show that a one-standard-deviation larger increase in political regime durability leads to a 0.1-standard-deviation larger decline in the share of newly circumcised women, conditional on the presence of an anti-FGM government policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了为何女性割礼这一有害传统在某些国家持续存在，而在其他国家已被根除。如果人们确信政府足够持久，能够为他们建立长期的替代安排，他们就更愿意放弃自己的传统。利用一个涵盖1970年至2013年23个国家的国家-民族面板数据集，以及非洲民族群体因国界而被人为分割的情况，我发现在存在反女性割礼政府政策的条件下，政治政权持久性每增加一个标准差，新近接受割礼的女性比例就会额外下降0.1个标准差。

articles.title_en: On the Estimation of Cross-Firm Productivity Spillovers with an Application to FDI
articles.title_cn: 关于企业间生产率溢出效应的估计及其在外商直接投资中的应用
articles.abstract_en: We develop a novel methodology for the proxy variable identification of firm productivity in the presence of productivity-modifying learning and spillovers, which facilitates a unified internally consistent analysis of the spillover effects among firms. Contrary to the popular two-step empirical approach, ours does not postulate contradictory assumptions about firm productivity across the estimation steps. Instead, we explicitly accommodate cross-sectional dependence in productivity induced by spillovers, which facilitates identification of both the productivity and spillover effects simultaneously. We apply our model to study cross-firm spillovers in China's electric machinery manufacturing, with a particular focus on productivity effects of inbound FDI.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种新的方法论，用于在存在生产率修正的学习和溢出效应的情况下，对企业生产率进行代理变量识别，这有助于对企业间溢出效应进行统一且内部一致的分析。与流行的两步实证方法相反，我们的方法在估计步骤之间没有对企业生产率设定矛盾的假设。相反，我们明确考虑了由溢出效应引起的生产率的横截面依赖性，这有助于同时识别生产率和溢出效应。我们将我们的模型应用于研究中国电机制造业中的企业间溢出效应，特别关注内向外商直接投资的生产率效应。

articles.title_en: Strategic Complements or Substitutes? The Case of Adopting Health Information Technology by U.S. Hospitals
articles.title_cn: 战略互补还是战略替代？美国医院采用健康信息技术的情形
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the adoption choice of electronic medical records by U.S. hospitals, which could exhibit strategic complements or substitutes. I find complementarities in adoption through a reduced-form analysis with instruments for unobserved market characteristics. I further develop a dynamic oligopoly model to allow for strategic timing incentives that are missing in the static model. Adopting a dominant local vendor could increase per period profits from adoption by 9.2% over choosing a marginal vendor. A counterfactual analysis suggests that an incentive program rewarding coordination, not just adoption, is more effective in achieving interoperability, especially before the widespread adoption of the technology.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了美国医院采用电子病历的选择，这可能表现出战略互补或战略替代。通过使用工具变量进行简化形式分析，以控制未观测的市场特征，我发现了采用中的互补性。我进一步开发了一个动态寡头垄断模型，以考虑静态模型中缺失的战略时机激励。采用占主导地位的本地供应商相比于选择边缘供应商，可使每期采用利润增加9.2%。反事实分析表明，奖励协调而非仅仅采用的激励计划在实现互操作性方面更为有效，尤其是在技术广泛采用之前。

articles.title_en: Impulse Purchases, Gun Ownership, and Homicides: Evidence from a Firearm Demand Shock
articles.title_cn: 冲动购买、枪支拥有与凶杀：来自枪支需求冲击的证据
articles.abstract_en: Do firearm purchase delay laws reduce aggregate homicide levels? Using variation from a six-month countrywide gun demand shock in 2012/2013, we show that U.S. states with legislation preventing immediate handgun purchases experienced smaller increases in handgun sales. Our findings indicate that this is likely driven by comparatively lower purchases among impulsive consumers. We then demonstrate that states with purchase delays also witnessed comparatively 2% lower homicide rates during the same period. Further evidence shows that lower handgun sales coincided primarily with fewer impulsive assaults and points toward reduced acts of domestic violence.
articles.abstract_cn: 枪支购买延迟法律是否会降低总体凶杀水平？利用2012/2013年为期六个月的全国性枪支需求冲击的变化，我们表明，美国那些立法禁止即时购买手枪的州，手枪销售增长较小。我们的研究结果表明，这可能是由于冲动消费者中的购买相对较低。然后我们证明，在同期，有购买延迟的州的凶杀率也相对较低，为2%。进一步的证据显示，手枪销售下降主要与冲动攻击减少同时发生，并指向家庭暴力行为的减少。

articles.title_en: Returns to Scale, Productivity, Measurement, and Trends in U.S. Manufacturing Misallocation
articles.title_cn: 规模报酬、生产率、测量与美国制造业错配的趋势
articles.abstract_en: Aggregate productivity suffers when workers and machines are not matched with their most productive uses. This paper builds a model that features industry-specific markups, industry-specific returns to scale, and establishment-specific distortions and uses it to measure the extent of this misallocation in the economy. Applying the model to restricted U.S. Census microdata on the manufacturing sector suggests that misallocation declined by 13% between 1982 and 2007. The finding of declining misallocation starkly contrasts with the 29% increase implied by the widely used assumptions that all establishments charge the same markup and have constant returns to scale.
articles.abstract_cn: 当工人和机器未与其最高生产率的用途相匹配时，总生产率会受损。本文构建了一个包含行业特定加成、行业特定规模报酬和机构特定扭曲的模型，并用其来衡量经济中这种错配的程度。将该模型应用于美国人口普查局关于制造业部门的受限微观数据，结果表明，在1982至2007期间，错配下降了13%。错配下降的发现与广泛使用的假设（所有机构收取相同的加成且具有恒定规模报酬）所隐含的29%增长形成鲜明对比。

articles.title_en: The Distribution of Households' Indebtedness and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
articles.title_cn: 家庭负债分布与货币政策的传导
articles.abstract_en: We investigate whether the dynamic response of aggregate consumption to monetary policy depends on the distribution of household debt relative to income. Using U.K. loan-level microdata, we propose a novel approach to isolate the fraction of households with a limited ability to smooth consumption. By exploiting time and cross-sectional variation, we show that consumption responds more to monetary policy when the share of highly indebted households is large, but find no state contingency with respect to the overall level of debt-to-income. Our results highlight the role of household heterogeneity for understanding monetary transmission to aggregate consumption.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了总消费对货币政策的动态反应是否取决于家庭债务相对于收入的分布。利用英国贷款层面的微观数据，我们提出了一种新方法来识别平滑消费能力有限的家庭比例。通过利用时间和横截面变化，我们表明当高负债家庭占比很大时，消费对货币政策的反应更大，但未发现总体债务收入比存在状态依赖性。我们的结果强调了家庭异质性在理解货币政策向总消费传导中的作用。

articles.title_en: Asymmetric Demand Response When Prices Increase and Decrease: The Case of Child Health Care
articles.title_cn: 价格上升与下降时的不对称需求响应：儿童医疗保健案例
articles.abstract_en: This study tests whether demand responds symmetrically to price increases and decreases—a seemingly obvious proposition under conventional demand theory that has not been rigorously tested. Exploiting the rapid expansion in Japanese municipal subsidies for child health care in a difference-in-differences framework, we find evidence against conventional demand theory: when coinsurance, our price measure, increases from 0% to 30%, the demand response is more than twice that to a price decrease from 30% to 0%. This result indicates that while economists and policymakers pay little attention, price change direction matters and should be incorporated into welfare analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究检验了需求是否对价格上升和下降做出对称响应——这一在传统需求理论下看似显而易见的命题尚未经过严格检验。利用日本市政儿童医疗补贴的快速扩张，在双重差分框架下，我们发现与传统需求理论相悖的证据：当我们的价格度量——共付额从0%增加到30%时，需求响应是价格从30%下降到0%时的两倍多。这一结果表明，尽管经济学家和政策制定者很少关注，价格变化方向确实重要，应纳入福利分析中。
